preconditions.description: The number of commands n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 1023 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: Each command's constant x_i is a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: Each command's operation is one of '&', '|', or '^'.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda f: (lambda x: eval('x' + ''.join(f))))(petya_program)(x) == (lambda f: (lambda x: eval('x' + ''.join(f))))(output_program)(x) for x in range(1024))
postconditions.description: The output program must produce the same result as Petya's program for all inputs x in the range [0, 1023]. Here, petya_program and output_program are the sequences of operations derived from the input and output, respectively.
The output program length k is between 0 and 5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:k+1])
postconditions.description: Each command in the output program uses one of '&', '|', or '^'.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 1023 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:k+1])
postconditions.description: Each command's constant in the output program is a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023 inclusive.
